author: stellaclown
quote: The problem with modern Rockstar is that they think they are smarter than they actually are.Rockstar relies on "satire" but presents it in such a condescending smug manner that it's just not only unfunny, but also **** least FIFA/COD devs know they make slop aimed at the lowest common denominator, Rockstar devs act like their games are art of the highest caliber when they just make empty, overrated and overpriced **** devoid of any soul or value.
